findings.claim: A small Dirichlet norm quotient for the first-order Dirac operator produces a small eigenvalue excluded by the strict-APS eigenvector statement
findings.evidence: Strict trace F+(A) has Green annihilator F+(A) plus kerA, with dim kerA4, so realization is not self-adjoint. T=-i d/dx on H1_0(0,L) has no nonzero eigenfunction for any lambda, but sin(pi x/L) has quotient pi/L. It gives a T* T singular-value conclusion, not a T eigenvalue. The printed two-parameter exponential bound does not absorb uniformly for all r/ell; metric variation also changes the principal symbol.
findings.counterevidence: No G2 counterexample. Along r=ell, scalar trace Poincare plus Kato/Lichnerowicz gives coercivity for all zero-trace spinors. This directly fixes the cutoff contradiction. Relative first-order perturbation estimates give diagonal kernel stability. Finite-dimensional Maslov and example arithmetic agree.
